previous_statement: The map w has the correctly typed source C^m, a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, and target A, a finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra. It is an extended c0*epsilon-inclusion because W.c0_cb=c0, and node 1.2 gives 0<=c0*epsilon<=t_3. Hence lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone makes w an extended t_3-inclusion. Calling it non-unital imposes no unit-preservation premise; its separately assumed near-unit error satisfies ||w(I_{C^m})-I_A||<=c0*epsilon<=t_3, and the unchanged atomic images are the same one-dimensional P_j.
